title: Find the IDs and diagnoses of patients who have at least two laboratory rec
question: Find the IDs and diagnoses of patients who have at least two laboratory records with abnormal C-reactive protein (CRP = '+') and also show elevated total cholesterol (T-CHO ≥ 250) in any lab test. Return up to five results ordered by patient ID.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P."XCL_058", P."XCL_064"
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_014" FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "XCL_045" = '+'
    GROUP BY "XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
AND P."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_014" FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "XCL_026" >= 250
)
ORDER BY P."XCL_058"
LIMIT 5
